description: Keeps agbar's own dependencies AND the versions it writes into generated projects current. Every update is a PR; scaffold-verify.yml must pass before it merges.

customManagers.description: Versions written into generated projects. Each pin is preceded by a `// renovate: datasource=npm depName=<package>` line naming the package it tracks.
Spring Boot / jjwt pins in the hand-written POM templates: `// renovate: datasource=maven depName=<group:artifact>` above a `const X = "1.2.3"`.

packageRules.description: Generated-project pins: keep the range's floor at the newest release (^12.1.2 -> ^12.2.0), so a new project starts from the version CI actually verified.
Spring Boot pins in generated POMs: a new release is worth a PR, but only CI proving a project builds against it can merge it.
Prisma's CLI, client and adapters must share a major, so they move together.
